about_the_game:
You knew in advance before the zombie crisis breake out, go to the supermarket to buy everything you need! Then stay at home and play your mobile phone in order to survive in this madness!

Game elements

■ Survival & construction: With limited resources, proper planning, and the use of raw materials to manufacture various necessary items, strive to survive for as long as possible in the zombie crisis!

■ Free exploration: Surrounded by zombies, explore various areas of the city, retrieve various resources, and try to survive!

■Help your Neighbor: Do your best to help the people in the community, provide materials, food, etc., help each other, and overcome difficulties together!

■Multiple endings: Depending on your behavior and choices, it can lead to various different endings. You can try playing multiple times to achieve different endings!

Thank you for your playing!:)
